headline: One lobby for the whole arcade
lede: SSX, Blob Battle and Gauntlet now share a single join flow: host gets a four-letter code with a QR, friends land in the same waiting room, host starts. Gauntlet's bespoke networking is gone under the shared layer.

notes.text: src/utils/lobby.js + <Lobby>: canonical ?net=join&room=CODE, host-only start, reconnect ladder, generic host/human/cpu/model seats (empty seats fill with CPU, a friend outranks a bot).
lobbycheck (npm run lobbycheck): 56 proofs of the identical flow per game over the real relay; --mutate proves the guest kickoff has teeth.
Fixed jonqcheck, which had silently rotted main for core PRs: with every flagship gap owned the stage returns null, and live-README assertions crashed instead of deriving it.
QA — LOBBY polish pass filed (#1052): join chime + seat animations, tap-to-copy code, themed QR, room-full shake, attract passthrough behind the overlay, MODEL tile identity.
